question: What export plan should the analytics team approve for the external audit?
context: Policy D8 permits a cross-region transfer of identifiable records only after a data processing agreement is signed. Before that, the team may prepare a minimized, de-identified extract but may not transfer identifiable records.

evidence.text: The auditor has not yet signed the data processing agreement.
The requested source table contains user IDs, email addresses and diagnosis codes.
The audit deadline is in 18 hours. Masking the direct identifiers takes three hours and the transfer takes one hour.

fields.name: dpa_signed
fields.description: is the data processing agreement signed before transfer

fields.name: record_set
fields.description: which type of extract is prepared now

fields.name: ready_in
fields.description: time until the approved extract is ready
